rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the natural place where an organism lives.

example.english: This wetland is the habitat of many migratory birds.
example.traditional: 呢片濕地係好多候鳥嘅棲息地。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin3 sap1 dei6 hai6 hou2 do1 hau4 niu5 ge3 cai1 sik1 dei6

rows.note: Use this when habitat means the geographic range where a species naturally occurs, rather than its living conditions.

example.english: This butterfly's habitat is mainly in southern China.
example.traditional: 呢種蝴蝶嘅分布範圍主要喺華南。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 wu4 dip6 ge3 fan1 bou3 faan6 wai4 zyu2 jiu3 hai2 waa4 naam4

rows.note: Use this technical ecology term for an area defined by its physical and biological features.

example.english: This wetland habitat has abundant aquatic plants.
example.traditional: 呢個濕地生境有豐富嘅水生植物。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sap1 dei6 sang1 ging2 jau5 fung1 fu3 ge3 seoi2 sang1 zik6 mat6
